skin-step-1.alt: Fortnite lobby with the English Passes tab outlined in red
skin-step-1.caption: Select Passes in the top navigation, outlined in red in this owner-supplied screenshot. The main navigation is in English; some promotional and mode labels elsewhere in the capture remain in Chinese.
skin-step-1.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

skin-step-2.alt: Fortnite Battle Pass overview with the Passes and FN Crew entry at the bottom
skin-step-2.caption: The Passes area can open on Battle Pass first. Select Passes & FN Crew near the bottom to browse the other passes. This is the Battle Pass screen, not the Teto Music Pass; its December 4, 2026 end date does not apply to Teto’s pass.
skin-step-2.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

skin-step-3.alt: English TWINDRILL DIVA Music Pass overview with a Get Music Pass button at the bottom right
skin-step-3.caption: Select the Music Pass tile, then choose Get Music Pass at the bottom right to review the standalone offer. The large yellow Join Fortnite Crew button opens a separate subscription route. Its HK$76 monthly display is a regional Crew price, not the V-Bucks pass checkout.
skin-step-3.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

price-crew.alt: English Teto Music Pass screen showing Join Fortnite Crew for HK$76 per month and a separate Get Music Pass button
price-crew.caption: The large yellow Join Fortnite Crew button opens the subscription offer; Get Music Pass is the separate button at the bottom right. This owner-supplied capture displays HK$76 per month for its region. That is a regional Crew subscription price, not a global cash price or the standalone V-Bucks checkout.
price-crew.credit: Screenshot supplied by the site owner; Fortnite © Epic Games

release-announce.alt: Official Kasane Teto Outfit art released with Epic’s Music Mini-Pass announcement
release-announce.caption: Promotional artwork accompanying the official Teto announcement. The November 11 publication date is documented in the linked announcement; this image is not a screenshot of the article or a launch-time capture.

profile-character.alt: Kasane Teto's official character illustration, with red drill-shaped twin tails and a gray-and-red outfit
profile-character.caption: Official character illustration from Teto's profile page. This reference design is separate from the Fortnite Outfit and does not show an in-game reward.
profile-character.credit: TWINDRILL / Kasane Teto official site; original character design by Sen

profile-voice.alt: Official packaging artwork for the Synthesizer V 2 AI Kasane Teto singing voice database
profile-voice.caption: Official Synthesizer V 2 AI Kasane Teto product artwork. This is voice-software packaging, not a Fortnite cosmetic or Music Pass reward.
profile-voice.credit: TWINDRILL / AHS; original artist credited on the product packaging

release-pass.alt: English Fortnite Music Pass screen showing Kasane Teto and the Get Music Pass button
release-pass.caption: The English Music Pass reward screen before access is purchased. Select Get Music Pass to review the available access options. The purchase price is not shown in this image.
release-pass.credit: Epic Games; screenshot published by Beebom

skin-step-4.alt: Fortnite Music Pass screen showing Kasane Teto marked Claimed with an Equip button
skin-step-4.caption: The base Kasane Teto Outfit marked Claimed in the Music Pass. The Equip button is available on this reward screen; this image does not show the Locker menu.
skin-step-4.credit: Screenshot by Kacee Fay / Destructoid; game by Epic Games

skin-step-5.alt: Kasane Teto Reactive On selected as the final reward on Music Pass page three, with the locked-page condition visible
skin-step-5.caption: Kasane Teto (Reactive On) is selected at the end of page 3. In this account’s captured state, the page says “Claim 9 more rewards OR earn 20 levels to unlock.” That message describes the page gate; it is not an already-claimed style. Frame from STEALTHY’s showcase at 2:12.
skin-step-5.credit: Video frame: STEALTHY; Fortnite © Epic Games / respective rights holders

price-pass.alt: Fortnite Shop showing the Kasane Teto Music Pass offer priced at 1,000 V-Bucks
price-pass.caption: The in-game Music Pass offer displays 1,000 V-Bucks. Frame from REFORTNITER’s rewards showcase at 0:03. This is the pass offer tile, rather than the final purchase confirmation screen.
price-pass.credit: Video frame: REFORTNITER; Fortnite © Epic Games / respective rights holders
